<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19083018" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%8B%9C%ED%8E%B8/83/#v19083018" target="_blank">시편 83:18</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>만물을 지으신</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">살아 계신 하느님,</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">영원토록 기억될</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">주 이름 여호와.</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">주의 회중 되는</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">큰 영예 주셨으니</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">주 영광 알리는 일</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">온 힘 다하리다.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 se">(후렴)</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sp">여호와, 여호와,</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sz">오, 주와 같은 분</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">땅과 하늘 어디에도</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">결코 없나이다.</p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sp">모두가 알게 하소서,</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">주 전능한 능력.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">여호와, 여호와,</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sz">여호와만 섬기리다.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sl"><span id="page9" class="pageNum refID" aria-hidden="true" data-no="9" data-before-text="9"> </span><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>주께서 원하는</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">무엇이든 되도록</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">우리를 도우시는</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sz">주 이름 여호와.</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sp">주의 증인 되는</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sz">친절 베푸셨으니</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sp">그 이름 지닌 우린</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sz">주 백성입니다.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 se">(후렴)</p>
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 sp">여호와, 여호와,</p>
<p id="p31" data-pid="31" class="p31 sz">오, 주와 같은 분</p>
<p id="p32" data-pid="32" class="p32 sp">땅과 하늘 어디에도</p>
<p id="p33" data-pid="33" class="p33 sz">결코 없나이다.</p>
<p id="p34" data-pid="34" class="p34 sp">모두가 알게 하소서,</p>
<p id="p35" data-pid="35" class="p35 sz">주 전능한 능력.</p>
<p id="p36" data-pid="36" class="p36 sp">여호와, 여호와,</p>
<p id="p37" data-pid="37" class="p37 sz">여호와만 섬기리다.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p38" data-pid="38" class="p38 se">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="14006014" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%97%AD%EB%8C%80%EA%B8%B0%ED%95%98/6/#v14006014" target="_blank">역대기하 6:14;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19072019" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%8B%9C%ED%8E%B8/72/#v19072019" target="_blank"> 시 72:19;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="23042008" href="/ko/%EB%9D%BC%EC%9D%B4%EB%B8%8C%EB%9F%AC%EB%A6%AC/%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC%EC%9A%A9-%EC%84%B1%EA%B2%BD/%EC%B1%85%EB%AA%85/%EC%9D%B4%EC%82%AC%EC%95%BC/42/#v23042008" target="_blank"> 이사야 42:8</a> 참조)</p>
</div>
<p id="p39" class="displayNone"> </p>
